Summary: Talks between the US and Iran, with mediators Pakistan and Qatar, have been postponed, the Swiss foreign ministry told The National on Friday. 'The planned talks between the US, Iran, Qatar and Pakistan have been postponed,' the ministry said. 'Switzerland remains ready to facilitate these talks. The relevant preparatory work at Burgenstock is continuing,' it added. The ministry did not provide a new date for the talks. The announcement came after the White House said on Thursday that US President JD Vance would not be departing for Switzerland as initially scheduled. Talks were planned to kick off the first round of negotiations aimed at securing a lasting peace agreement within 60 days aft
